paragraphs.source_en: Strangely enough, Meitei did not launch into his usual stream of random commentary on this fine piece of writing. After a pause, he turned to Kushami and asked, “Why don’t you gather these little essays of yours into a volume and dedicate it to someone?” The master said, as if it were nothing at all, “How would it be if I dedicated it to you?” Meitei answered only, “I absolutely decline.” Then he began trimming his nails with the scissors he had earlier shown off before the master’s wife.

paragraphs.source_en: Kangetsu asked Tofu, “Do you know that Miss Kaneda?” Tofu said, “Ever since we invited her to our reading meeting this spring, I have been on friendly terms with her. Whenever I stand before that young lady, I am somehow deeply moved. For a while afterward, whether I compose poetry or waka, inspiration comes to me delightfully and in full force. The reason this collection contains so many love poems, I think, is entirely that I receive inspiration from such a friend of the opposite sex. Therefore I must express my heartfelt gratitude to that young lady, and I took this opportunity to dedicate my collection to her. They say that, from ancient times, no poet without an intimate female friend has ever written truly fine poetry.” With the trace of a smile, Kangetsu said, “Is that really so?”

paragraphs.source_en: Even when a gathering of these lovers of idle talk gets together, it seems such nonsense cannot go on endlessly forever. Nor was I under any obligation to listen all day to their monotonous chatter, so I took my leave and went out into the garden to hunt for mantises. The westering sun filtered in mottled patches through the thick green leaves of the paulownia, and on its trunk the autumn cicadas were crying with all their might. By tonight, perhaps, a shower might come.

paragraphs.source_zh: 尽管这些喜爱乱讲一通的人聚集在一起，但看来这种胡扯也不能总是这样无休止地继续下去。而我也没有义务整天听他们这种毫无变化的闲谈，于是我只好失陪，到院子里捉螳螂去了。西斜的太阳在绿荫浓郁的梧桐叶隙间洒下点点斑斑的影子，秋蝉在它的枝干上拼命鸣叫不停。今夜说不定还会有一阵风雨袭来哩。
